{"code": "import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# We have already filtered and deduplicated the data
# Now compute the response rate within each severity stratum, by arm

# Create a summary table: response rate by severity and arm
table = pd.crosstab(df["severity"], df["arm"], values=df["responded"], aggfunc="mean", margins=True)
print("Response rate by severity and arm:")
print(table)

# Extract stratum-specific response rates
treatment_mild = table.loc["mild", "treatment"]
treatment_moderate = table.loc["moderate", "treatment"]
treatment_severe = table.loc["severe", "treatment"]

control_mild = table.loc["mild", "control"]
control_moderate = table.loc["moderate", "control"]
control_severe = table.loc["severe", "control"]

# Compute stratum-specific differences (treatment - control)
diff_mild = treatment_mild - control_mild
diff_moderate = treatment_moderate - control_moderate
diff_severe = treatment_severe - control_severe

print(f"\nStratum-specific differences (treatment - control):")
print(f"mild: {diff_mild:.4f}")
print(f"moderate: {diff_moderate:.4f}")
print(f"severe: {diff_severe:.4f}")

# Now compute the overall difference using standardisation (direct adjustment)
# Use the overall severity distribution as the reference

# Proportion of patients in each severity stratum in the total population
p_mild = table.loc["All", "mild"] / table.loc["All", "All"]
p_moderate = table.loc["All", "moderate"] / table.loc["All", "All"]
p_severe = table.loc["All", "severe"] / table.loc["All", "All"]

# Standardised response rate under treatment (using overall severity distribution)
standardised_treatment = (p_mild * treatment_mild) + (p_moderate * treatment_moderate) + (p_severe * treatment_severe)

# Standardised response rate under control
standardised_control = (p_mild * control_mild) + (p_moderate * control_moderate) + (p_severe * control_severe)

# Standardised treatment effect (difference in proportions)
treatment_effect = standardised_treatment - standardised_control

print(f"\nStandardised treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect:.4f}")

# Also compute the raw difference for comparison
raw_treatment_rate = table.loc["All", "treatment"]
raw_control_rate = table.loc["All", "control"]
raw_effect = raw_treatment_rate - raw_control_rate
print(f"Raw difference (treatment - control): {raw_effect:.4f}")

# Print the full table again to verify
print("\nFinal table:")
print(table)"}
